question: In a certain code language, 'CAMERA' is written as 'NBDBSF' and 'DOCTOR' is written as 'DPESPU'. How will 'CHURCH' be written in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 
The pattern followed in the given codes is:
 All the alphabets are increased to 1 positional value.

 Position of first & third alphabets and fourth & sixth are interchanged.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09d951303932156a452f97348532d8baaccecdc2e5e5e7a9091fed8c6a958be2.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25f1a72bc9c740360e404cffc7680b94a03af0ae853b1e4a4b1da9e940ccaf4c.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e708dd9fffd70ac27bc0300b5adfe7b02f14d2aeeb25cadb2eeed3b3b618cc7.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 3)**
